svg.title: dbt Lineage: Staging Views to the wh_gold Star Schema
svg.desc: dbt model lineage from silver staging views (stg_positions, stg_returns) through conformed dimensions (dim_date, dim_portfolio, dim_benchmark, dim_instrument SCD2) to incremental fact models in the wh_gold star schema.
svg.text: dbt Lineage & Gold Star Schema in Fabric Warehouse
Silver Staging Views ➔ Conformed Dimension Models (SCD2) ➔ Incremental Facts in wh_gold
STAGE 1: SILVER LAKEHOUSE DBT STAGING VIEWS

g.title: stg_positions (staging view) — A dbt staging view reading silver positions from the lakehouse via a three-part source name.
g.text: • Validates not_null(position_id); standardizes column aliases & data types

g.title: stg_returns (staging view) — A dbt staging view reading silver daily returns from the lakehouse.
g.text: • Validates not_null(as_of_date); feeds return & risk calculation models

svg.text: STAGE 2: CONFORMED DIMENSIONS & SCD TYPE 2 ISOLATION

g.title: dim_date — A conventional calendar dimension joined by every fact model.
dim_portfolio — A conformed portfolio dimension built from stg_positions, joined by every fact.
dim_benchmark — A conformed benchmark dimension built from stg_returns, joined by return and risk facts.
dim_instrument (SCD Type 2) — The one dimension in gold that preserves full attribute history via SCD Type 2.

g.aria-label: SCD Type 2 only on one dimension
g.title: SCD Type 2 only on one dimension — Mixing one Type 2 dimension with three Type 1 dimensions in the same gold layer is a real design tension to manage deliberately.
g.text: • Naive ID join silently corrupts historical

svg.text: STAGE 3: INCREMENTAL FACT MODELS & WH_GOLD STAR SCHEMA

g.title: fact_positions (incremental) — Daily position holdings by portfolio and instrument, built incrementally.
g.text: • Grain: 1 row per position per day

g.title: fact_returns_daily (incremental) — Daily time-weighted returns by portfolio, joined to benchmark and date.
g.text: • Grain: 1 row per portfolio per day

g.title: fact_risk_measures (incremental) — VaR, exposures, and sensitivities by portfolio and instrument, joined via the effective-dated instrument key.
g.text: • Grain: 1 row per measure type per day

g.title: fact_transactions (incremental) — Buys, sells, corporate actions, and cash flows, keyed by source system and transaction id.
wh_gold star schema — The published gold layer: four facts joined to conformed dimensions in the warehouse.
g.text: • Unified Serving: Conformed star schema serving Direct Lake to Power BI and ad-hoc T-SQL queries
• Automated Quality Gate: Scheduled Airflow DAG executes dbt test (uniqueness, not-null, FK relationships)
• Direct Lake BI Integration: Delta columns read directly from OneLake with zero import duplication or refresh lag

svg.text: Fabric Codex — Original Diagram, August 2026. Sourced from Microsoft Fabric Warehouse & dbt Lineage Architecture.
